item.title: Actionable Alerts And Dashboards
item.description: Initial guidance for actionable alerts, useful dashboards, ownership, and SRE-style signal quality.

item.title: From Local IaC Labs To Production-Ready Patterns
item.description: A practical SRE view of how local Terraform, Docker, Helm, Kafka, and observability labs can become production-ready infrastructure patterns without pretending the lab is production.

item.title: Local SLI Labs With Prometheus Grafana And cAdvisor
item.description: Field note for using a local Docker and Terraform lab to validate service-level indicators with Prometheus, Grafana, and cAdvisor.

item.title: Operating In A GitOps Environment: Practices That Hold Up
item.description: Opinionated practices for infrastructure teams working in a GitOps model: commit messages, semver for infrastructure, CI-triggered CD tradeoffs, and deployment automation patterns that survive production use.

item.title: Post-Incident Follow-Up
item.description: Initial post-incident follow-up model for timelines, contributing factors, corrective actions, and measurable system improvements.

item.title: Removing DNS Search Domain Drift Across Multi-Site RKE2 Clusters
item.description: A production walkthrough of auditing, diagnosing, and remediating DNS search domain drift across five RKE2 cluster sites, including netplan staging, systemd-resolved link-level debugging, and a Subiquity YAML indentation trap.

item.title: Troubleshooting Kubernetes Storage Migration To vSphere CSI
item.description: A practical incident walkthrough for Kubernetes monitoring PVC failures, stale CSI storage, vSphere CSI attach and mount validation, and the disk.EnableUUID requirement.

item.title: Refactoring A vSphere Terraform Repo Into Environment Roots And Shared Modules
item.description: A Terraform infrastructure project writeup about reorganizing a vSphere repo into environment roots, shared modules, templates, and archived legacy state.

item.title: Using LLMs During Infrastructure Troubleshooting Without Turning Off Your Brain
item.description: Practical lessons for using LLMs during infrastructure troubleshooting while preserving operator judgment, validation, and evidence-based debugging.

item.title: Breaking Barriers: The DevOps Silos Anti-Pattern
item.description: Part 1 of the DevOps Dirty Dozen series: how organizational silos undermine DevOps collaboration and what teams can do about it.
